headlines.title: Tony Robbins: 4 rules the world's greatest investors follow
headlines.summary: Author, entrepreneur, and philanthropist Tony Robbins sits down with Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi to break down the four things every elite investor does in common, and why you should run your money like a side business.

headlines.title: Starbucks' Bearista comeback sparks a surprising resale mystery
headlines.summary: The coffee giant’s new $40 mystery boxes are selling out, but overseas sellers are offering dozens of its rarest collectibles at unexpectedly low prices.

headlines.title: Veterans Day starts with free coffee and breakfast, if you time it right
headlines.summary: Denny’s serves a free Grand Slam until noon on Nov. 11 for veterans, while IHOP’s pancake deal runs into the evening. Starbucks extends its free coffee offer to military spouses.

headlines.title: Has Starbucks (SBUX) Run Too Far Ahead As Fresh 2027 Guidance Resets Valuation?
headlines.summary: Starbucks (SBUX) is back in focus after reporting fourth quarter and full year results on October 29, 2026, along with fresh 2027 guidance that points to slightly lower revenue as its China business shifts models. The fresh earnings and 2027 outlook arrived after a strong run in Starbucks shares. A 30.9% year to date share price return and a 21.2% one month share price gain point to building momentum as investors reassess both growth prospects and risks.

headlines.title: Can SBUX Deliver 18% EPS Growth Despite a 1% Revenue Decline in FY27?
headlines.summary: Starbucks targets 18% EPS growth in fiscal 2027 despite a 1% revenue decline, backed by margin expansion, cost savings and an additional fiscal week.

description: Starbucks Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, operates as a roaster, marketer, and retailer of coffee internationally. The company operates through three segments: North America, International, and Channel Development. Its stores offer coffee, tea, and other beverages, roasted whole beans and ground coffees, complementary food, packaged coffees, single-serve products, and ready-to-drink beverages; and various food products, such as pastries, breakfast sandwiches, and lunch items. The company also licenses its trademarks through licensed stores, and grocery and foodservice accounts. The company offers its products under the Starbucks Coffee, Teavana, Seattle's Best Coffee, Ethos, and Starbucks Reserve brands. Starbucks Corporation was founded in 1971 and is based in Seattle, Washington.
